# netbox_custom_link (Data Source)

Reads a single NetBox custom link (`/api/extras/custom-links/`) by `id`, `name` or filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_custom_link" "weather" {
  name = "weather"
}

output "weather_link_url" {
  value = data.netbox_custom_link.weather.link_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/extras/custom-links/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Read-Only

- `button_class` (String) The class of the first link in a group will be used for the dropdown button. Valid values: `default`, `blue`, `indigo`, `purple`, `pink`, `red`, `orange`, `yellow`, `green`, `teal`, `cyan`, `gray`, `black`, `white`, `ghost-dark`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `created` (String) Created.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `group_name` (String) Links with the same group will appear as a dropdown menu. Defaults to an empty string.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `link_text` (String) Jinja2 template code for link text.
- `link_url` (String) Jinja2 template code for link URL.
- `new_window` (Boolean) Force link to open in a new window. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `object_types` (Set of String) Object Types.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `url` (String) Url.
- `weight` (Number) Weight. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.
